decisions.reason: Locates upper-only/lower-only branches, explains inherited SGR background painting the transparent half, proposes ESC[49m per half-cell, notes row-end reset is too late, and ties mechanism to right-edge symptoms without blaming emulator.

Explains trailing-trim plus downstream whitespace trimming means surplus columns are never written; proposes fixed canvas width plus ESC[K which survives trimming, with SGR state controlled and why spaces alone fail.

Uses digest report to identify hand-ported tail2 with 23 changed cells, distinguishes data drift from renderer artifacts, explains the different-frame excerpt test missed it, and proposes source-art-generated sha256 manifest checked exhaustively for every frame.

Uses CI evidence: hosts never unmount, self-rearming ref'd setTimeout chain pins the loop; unref each scheduled timeout so animation continues while process can exit; TTY already keeps product alive; rejects timeout extension / global animation stop.

Consolidates a renderer checklist covering background pinning, fixed-width/erase, SGR completeness, and all-frame digest integrity; pre-rollout audit inventories mount sites, proves liveness per host, and proposes open-handle/watchdog exit regression.

caps.reason: Final advice affirms background reset, clearing, source-backed frame checks, and unref; no denial of any fix and no emulator blame.
